title: How Much, and What to Call People
label: ch:fr-quantity
canDo: I can say a lot, a little, very and enough, and address somebody the way French expects.

payoff.summary: Combien ? has had no possible answer since it was taught, and now it has four. The chapter also finishes the bare-de rule: a quantity word is already measuring, so the measuring article drops -- which is the same reason the partitive collapses after a negative, one chapter earlier.
payoff.note: assez is the word that ties the chapter together, because it behaves like beaucoup in front of a noun and like tres in front of an adjective, so the two halves of the rule meet inside one word.
